pr_title: Update leader election resource type flag description
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind cleanup

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

Removes "(default)" after endpoints which may not be true, and adds other leader election resource types which have been added since this flag description was originally written.

Compared to the example in the linked issue, the --help for this flag is now:

```
--leader-elect-resource-lock string
The type of resource object that is used for locking during leader election.
Supported options are 'endpoints', 'configmaps', 'leases', 'endpointsleases' and 'configmapsleases'. (default "leases")
```

I changed from using backquotes to single quotes since pflag tries to use the first substring in backquotes as the type of the flag (it was reporting the type as `endpoints` before).

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #83391

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:

```release-note
NONE
```

issue_context.title: Inaccurate help text in leader election config flag
issue_context.body:
In this flag
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/fdd1f27ce9cea3b7880f91a31e013b81001879ca/pkg/client/leaderelectionconfig/config.go#L43-L45
which sets the type of resource used for leader election, the default value is taken from the `l.ResourceLock` set in the `LeaderElectionConfiguration` passed to this function. If that value is not `"endpoints"` (such as in https://github.com/kubernetes/autoscaler/pull/2012) then the --help text for this flag can look like:
```
--leader-elect-resource-lock endpoints
The type of resource object that is used for locking during leader election.
Supported options are endpoints (default) and `configmaps`. (default "leases")
```
suggesting two different default values, since the spf13/pflag library adds the actual default to the end of the description.

The `(default)` should be removed, and also the description should be updated with the [other leader election options that are now supported by client-go](https://github.com/kubernetes/client-go/blob/0ebb3d5f4902894b317beeb945c738fa5c813911/tools/leaderelection/resourcelock/interface.go#L30-L34).

review_comments: I'm all for updating the documentation to reflect the new options. A little disturbed  by us not having a working default. I believe endpoints should be the default as it was the original behavior and so that is the backward compatible behavior.

The default is whatever `l.ResourceLock` string is passed to `BindFlags` in the configuration. In https://github.com/kubernetes/autoscaler/pull/2012 this was intentionally changed from "endpoints" to "leases", which is why the help text was no longer correct.

Any code that still passes "endpoints" in the options to this function will continue to have endpoints as the default.
